name: last_final_rush_hour_benchmark_600
description: A reinforcement-learning benchmark suite (600 episodes/environments) evaluating agent performance on rush-hour style traffic/flow problems or similar sequential-decision tasks. It measures how well agents learn policies to optimize traffic-flow metrics or solve puzzle-like control objectives over episodes. Benchmarks are typically used to compare RL algorithms on sample efficiency and final return.
reputation: A niche MultiRL benchmark used in reinforcement-learning research and algorithm comparisons; modest community adoption.
